sentences.text: First Bail Application No. 449 of 2024 Adil ........Applicant
Versus State of Uttarakhand
........Respondent Present:-
Mr. Rajendra Singh Azad, Advocate for the applicant  appeared through video conferencing.

Mr. Virendra Singh Azad, A.G.A. with Ms. Rangoli Purohit,
 Brief Holder for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Applicant Adil is in judicial custody in FIR/Case Crime No.720 of 2023, dated 25.12.2023, under Section 376 IPC, Police Station Patel Nagar, District Dehradun.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant and the victim came in contact through some social media app.
They were in conversation through audio and video calls.
The applicant was abroad during that period.
The family members of the applicant fixed the marriage of the applicant with the victim.
On 03.11.2023, when the applicant returned from abroad.
Their marriage was fixed on 01.12.2023, but on that date the marriage was not solemnized.
Thereafter, the FIR records that on 07.12.2023, the applicant visited the house of the victim.
There was no-one in the family and they established physical relations.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that what is stated in the FIR, nothing like that has happened; the victim is still in touch with the applicant; she is visiting him in the jail.
5. State to file objections within four weeks.
6. List this case on 22.04.2024.
